items.t: In West Cambie, Richmond, houses sold at a median of $1,650,000 across 27 sales, and the middle half closed between $1,546,750 and $1,902,857. The median house sat 42 days and sold for 94.2% of list.
West Cambie, Richmond: 35 townhomes sold at a median of $1,050,000, with the middle half between $941,900 and $1,089,500. The median townhome took 35 days to sell and closed at 97.2% of list.

236 condos sold in West Cambie, Richmond at a median of $630,500 (middle half $554,450 to $757,750). A typical condo in West Cambie, Richmond spent 21 days on the market and closed at 96.5% of the asking price.

How West Cambie compares with the rest of Richmond

items.t: Houses in West Cambie have the 14th highest median of 23 Richmond sub-areas, $1,650,000. Hamilton RI is lowest at $1,198,800 and Seafair highest at $2,428,000. Westwind ($1,589,500) sits just below and Garden City ($1,667,000) sits just above.

Of 22 Richmond sub-areas with 5 or more townhome sales, West Cambie ranks 7th highest at $1,050,000; the range is $794,000 (Brighouse) to $1,213,900 (Woodwards). Garden City ($1,029,000) sits just below and Bridgeport RI ($1,062,500) sits just above.

Condos in West Cambie have the second highest median of 14 Richmond sub-areas, $630,500. Granville is lowest at $186,500 and Steveston South highest at $675,000. Brighouse ($620,000) sits just below and Steveston South ($675,000) sits just above.
